profile_text.body:
SoundHound AI, Inc. is a for-profit public company headquartered in Claymont, Delaware, trading under the ticker SOUN, with a CIK of 0001840856. Its website describes it as building conversational AI agents for the real world, with its OASYS platform powering voice-native AI agents that handle service, operations, and commerce conversations for enterprise brands.

The site presents the technology as agentic AI and quotes unnamed customers saying it lets them resolve more requests faster, improve the quality of each interaction, and scale operations as demand grows; that franchisees process orders more efficiently with voice AI support for employees during peak hours; and that hybrid cloud and embedded connectivity deliver always-on voice experiences for customers on the go. No specific deployments or partners are named in the material.

The company's litigation exposure is concentrated in Delaware, with 33 matters recorded there. No lawsuits, products, or MCP servers are otherwise listed for it.
